arabic text: MEI BINT E ALI HOON\nAEY SHAM KEH LOGO MEI BINT E ALI HOON
english translation text: I am the daughter of Ali\nO people of Shaam, I am the daughter of Ali.
I am the inheritor of the Verse of Purification;\nI am the honour of the Prophet.

arabic text:
BAZAAR SE DARBAR MEI LEH AYE HO MUJ KO
CHAHO TOU JALA SAKTIEE HOON KHUTBO SE MEI TUM
KO
SABIR KI BEHAN HOON JO MEI KHAMOSH KHARI HOON
english translation text:
You have brought me through the
marketplace into the court.
Yet, if I wish, my sermons can set your falsehood ablaze.
I am the patient one’s sister; that is why I stand silent.

arabic text: AFSOOS KANIZI MEI USSE MANG RAHEY HO\nTUM JIS KEH GHULAMO KI GHULAMI MEI RAHEY HO\nYEH ZULM NA HO GA KABHI MEI ZINDA ABHI HOON
english translation text: Shame! You ask for her as a slave,\nthough you yourselves lived as servants of her family’s servants.\nThis oppression will never succeed while I remain alive.

arabic text:
TUM APNEY PAYAMBAR KO AGAR DIKHNA CHAHO
NAZEY PE JO YEH SAR HAI ISSEY GHOUR SE DEKHO
HUMSHAKAL E PAYAMBAR HAI YEH MEI IS KI PHUPI HO
ON
english translation text:
To see your Prophet,
look carefully at the head upon the spear.
He resembles the Prophet,
and I am his aunt.

arabic text:
AUR ISS SE KATHAN WAQT KYA HO GAA MERE MABO
OD
FIZA KEH TARAF DAR HAI DARBAR MEI MAJOOD
MEI PUSHT PE FIZA KEH KHARI DEKH RAHE HOON
english translation text:
What hour could be more difficult, O my Lord?
I fear for Fizza,
who stands present in the court.
I stand behind Fizza—you can see me there.

arabic text: ZEHRA KO BHI DARBAR MEI TUM NEH THA BULAYA\nDARBAR MAY MEI BHI HO MAGAR FARQ HAI ITNAA\nPARDEY MEI THI WOH AUR MEI BE PARDA KARI HOON
english translation text: You summoned Zahra to a court as well.\nI too stand in a court, but the difference is this:\nshe was behind a veil, while I have been made to stand unveiled.

arabic text: ZANJEERO MEI JAKRA JO YEH BEIMAAR KHRAA HAI\nSAJDA ISEY KAABEY KI FASEELO NEH KIYA HAI
english translation text: This ailing man bound in chains\nwas once honoured by the very walls of the Kaaba.

arabic text: MANSAB MEI BARA WOH HAI MEI RISHTEY MEI BARI H\nOON
english translation text: He is greater in rank,\nthough I am older in relation.

arabic text:
ZINDA THA TOU DAR DAR KEH HAMESHAA HE LAREY
HO
AB SAR HAI TOU HONTO PE CHARI MAR RAHEY HO
TUM KITNEY BAHADDUR HO MEI YEH DIKH RAHI HOON
english translation text:
While he was alive, you fought him only in fear.
Now that only his head remains,
you strike his lips with a cane.
How brave you are—I can see your courage now.

arabic text: HONEH LAGI DARBAR MEI MUSHTARKA AZANEIN\n“REHAN” IDHAR NAAM E NABI GUNJA FIZZA MEI\n(BIBI NEH KAHA FAKHR SE) MEI JEET GAYI HOON
english translation text: As competing calls to prayer began in the court,\n‘Rehan’ says the Prophet’s name echoed through the air.\n(The Lady said proudly:) I have won.
